# Scala CLI

> Scala CLI is a command-line tool to compile, run, test, package, and explore Scala code. It is the default Scala runner (`scala`) shipped with the language since Scala 3.5.0. Prefer single-module projects, scripts, education, and prototyping over large multi-module builds.

Scala CLI configuration can live in `//> using` directives inside source files or as CLI flags. CLI options override directives. Most docs below have clean Markdown mirrors under `/llm/` for LLM consumption; HTML docs remain canonical for humans.

## Start here

- [Overview (Markdown)](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/llm/overview.md): What Scala CLI is and what it can do
- [Install (Markdown)](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/llm/install.md): Install commands for macOS, Linux, Windows, and GitHub Actions
- [Getting started (HTML)](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/getting_started): First script, project, dependencies, tests, IDE
- [Install page (HTML)](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/install): Quick start plus advanced installation

## Commands

- [Commands index (Markdown)](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/llm/commands.md): Important sub-commands and defaults
- [Commands basics (HTML)](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/commands/basics): Inputs, defaults, and core workflow
- [run](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/commands/run): Run Scala code (default when inputs are passed)
- [compile](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/commands/compile): Compile sources
- [test](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/commands/test): Compile and run tests
- [repl](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/commands/repl): Interactive Scala shell
- [package](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/commands/package): Package as JAR or other formats
- [fmt](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/commands/fmt): Format code

- [Dependencies (HTML)](https://scala-cli.virtuslab.org/docs/guides/introduction/dependencies): Adding libraries
